text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“—I'll put your luggage up top too,
Trainer.”
choice_data_list: Thanks. I'll leave the tea by the window, alright?
Thank you. I'll leave the tea by the window, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A bento on my lap.
In my hand, a hot spring trip voucher that Cesario won in the raffle."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Now that things around us have finally settled down,
the two of us took this opportunity to go on a trip."
choice_data_list: Thank you so much for inviting me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"No, thank you
for keeping me company."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Since we have this wonderful opportunity, let's enjoy it to the absolute fullest, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Ah, there it is! This is the one!

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, yes, that's the one!
Spot on~!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~ Fufu!
I'm so glad I found it on my own!
choice_data_list: Found one here too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying so, I showed Cesario the small jade-colored stone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The pebble, a local specialty of this region, sparkles brightly in the sunlight.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A talisman stone for health and longevity...
Just looking at it brings peace to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
" 'Your lifespan extends by the number of them you find.'
I feel like I understand why
that legend has been passed down."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Right!
Let's keep this momentum going and find more and more!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Our dream will take time, so until it comes true... No!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So that even after it comes true,
the two of us can stay healthy and full of energy together!
choice_data_list: —Yeah, that's right!
――Yeah, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I crouch down next to Cesario and sift through the riverbed.
As I do, I realize a smile has crept onto my face.
choice_data_list: ("Our dream is"... huh?)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I've ended up dragging someone else
into my own outrageous dream—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "‘I must take responsibility,’ I thought."
choice_data_list: (At first, it was 'my own', wasn't it?)
(At first, it was 'my own', right?)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
âAh, Trainer!
That area over there is sparkling so much!
Maybe there's a whole bunch of them...!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
after enjoying sightseeing to their heart's content...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was such a nice bath.
I'm warmed right to the core♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, it was so good I feel like taking another bath before bed.
Yeah, enough that I want to take another bath before bed.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right.
I feel like I'll have wonderful dreams tonight...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah! In that case... after we finish dinner,
would you like to go out for some night air?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Let's take a stroll through the night...
and then soak in the hot springs again♪"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There are mountains, hot springs, and even the sea.
It truly is a wonderful place...
choice_data_list: You're right...
You're right...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shoulder to shoulder, the two felt the night sea breeze.
Without a word spoken, only the sound of waves echoed—until.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*whirl-whirl-whirl-whirl*...... *BOOM!!*)
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Wow...! 
Fireworks! It's fireworks, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah... Wait, what a coincidence!?
Y-yeah... Huh, what a coincidence!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Out of nowhere...!
Could there have been a festival nearby...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*whistle~*...... *BOOM!!* *BA-BA-BOOM!!*)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...It's truly beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“—For both us and fireworks,
the time we can bloom in all our glory is truly fleeting. But...”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: As long as we keep passing it down, the flowers will never wither.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I must keep passing it down. For as long as my—as long as our strength allows, forever.
choice_data_list: (…Some things never change, huh)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze, unwavering at all times.
Her dream, for which she set her very heart ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Things that have changed. Things that haven't.
I'm sure there are plenty more of both, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What they all have in common is—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is something the matter, Trainer?
Is there something on my face—
choice_data_list: I was thinking I should cherish it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ? Treasure it...?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Here's to you, and to your dream, from now on too.
Yeah. Always—supporting you and your dreams.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer. And even if that ends,
as the partner to her dreams. Always."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Hehe, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That is truly, deeply reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I was a little surprised.
I never imagined you would convey it to me like this.
choice_data_list: Well, we're on a trip after all... and above all else,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I turned fully toward Cesario and reached out my hand.
choice_data_list: Your resolve made me want to answer in kind.
Seeing your resolve made me want to step up and match it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (...Ah, that's right. This... this person is—)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (That night I decided on our contract, you reached out your hand to me just like this.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (To someone like me, who harbors such a wild dream, they laid out such a grand plan...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (And so, I took that hand...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —...Me too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Same here, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I will cherish it all, too.
You, your dream, and the resolve
you've placed in me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: So please, let us continue walking this path together.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Let us walk this long dream together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario's hand rests over mine.
My heart beat gently, weaving a quiet poem.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hands intertwined, gazes met, heartbeats aligned.
—And then.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu, fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Geez, why are you laughing...!
This isn't a laughing matter... Hehe!"
choice_data_list: Right back at you! Haha!
Right back at you! Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Because when I actually thought about it calmly, it just felt so silly... Ahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before we knew it, the fireworks were over.
Only our laughter drifted across the cool, gentle waves.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Haaah. Laughing so much has made me kind of hungry.
choice_data_list: Right. What would be good at this hour?
Yeah. What would be good around this time?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...If we're watching calories, maybe the hot spring carrots?
Then again, since we came all this way on a trip—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking side by side.
With the same stride, at the same pace, along the same path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a moment in which I felt an irreplaceable bond with Cesario...
